requirements:
envoy==1.0.0
kafka-python==2.0.2
Jinja2==3.1.2
PyYAML==6.0
sphinx==7.2.6
sphinx-rtd-theme==1.3.0
Pygments==2.16.1
docutils==0.20.1
dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "-c", "print('Envoy documentation build environment ready')"]
explanation: Generated requirements.txt includes pinned versions for stability: envoy (placeholder version), kafka-python for Kafka support, Jinja2 for templating, PyYAML for YAML parsing, Sphinx and related packages for documentation building. Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim base, installs dependencies from requirements.txt, and sets up a simple default command.
